G.name: Wise Guardian
G.description: An ancient, calm male voice, deep and warm, slow and deliberate, gentle authority, like a kind mentor speaking softly inside a vast clock tower.
G.anchor_text: Time moves through this clock like a river. Sit with me a while, and listen closely.

L.name: Little girl
L.description: A bright, curious little girl about eight years old, American, soft and sincere, a little breathy with wonder.
L.anchor_text: I always wonder what the stars are doing when nobody is looking up at them.
